summary: T22 evidence binds session ownership, incremental hot-path state and unknown-material fail-closed behavior to the integrated candidate.
facts: Material CAS advances once only after an allowed material action and task lanes bind exact provider, session, task epoch and proposal digest.
The split-state and critic checkpoint gates preserve incremental persisted state and bounded lock ownership rather than replaying authority history in the hook path.

acceptance.clause: 一个 lane 的暂停、任务切换和授权不会污染无关会话
acceptance.fact: Denied or read-only observations from another session leave the proposal material CAS unchanged, while the current task lane requires an exact session and epoch binding.

acceptance.clause: Hook 不全量重放历史，慢验证不占状态锁，审计 cursor 可持久恢复
acceptance.fact: The hook consumes persisted material sequence and task-lane/checkpoint projections; exact contract writes occur under the short state lock while independent critic evidence remains outside that mutation path.

acceptance.clause: 未知或物质动作在守卫不可用时拒绝，窄只读诊断仍可用
acceptance.fact: Unknown or material execution remains fail closed at the session-bound authority boundary, while denied and read-only observations remain non-authorizing and do not mutate material CAS.
